title: Robin Rendle: the whole site is a Finder window
note: The site is laid out like a macOS Finder window: a sidebar tree of folders (years, Stories) with .webp file names, a thumbnail grid of photos on the right, a status bar with date, time and Email, plus a filter field and dark mode toggle. Essays open as documents. Worth reusing: one strong metaphor taken all the way. For Petra, a metaphor from her own world (a repo, a merge request list, a component library) could do the same job.
